benchmark_meta.note: Measured empirical C++17 FFI ABI and memory-sanitization benchmarks on this host. MedGemma-4B INT4 weight footprint (~2.0 GB raw, ~2.3-2.6 GB with overhead) is published model-size math, distinct from these measured FFI/wipe/route benchmarks.

medgemma_4b_weight_specs.note: 4B params x 0.5 bytes = ~2.0 GB raw INT4; ~2.3-2.6 GB with overhead vs ~8.0 GB BF16. Published model-size math, distinct from measured FFI/wipe/route benchmarks.
